artists.name: Aliyev Farid
artists.bio: Farid works with layered surfaces, muted pigments, and fragments of urban memory collected around Baku.
artists.statement: I treat the canvas as a room where traces can stay visible: touch, silence, distance, and the pressure of time.

artists.name: Gunel Agayeva
artists.bio: Gunel combines paper, textile, mineral tones, and archival gestures into quiet material compositions.
artists.statement: My practice is about fragile systems: the things we keep, cover, fold, and later rediscover.

artists.name: Orxhan Huseynov
artists.bio: Orxhan explores weight, shadow, and imperfect geometry through compact sculptural forms.
artists.statement: I look for the moment when a solid object begins to feel temporary, almost like a thought.

artists.name: Sabina Shikhli
artists.bio: Sabina creates monochrome studies of interiors, bodies, and transitional city spaces.
artists.statement: Photography lets me hold the interval between a place being empty and being remembered.

artists.name: Elnur Babayev
artists.bio: Elnur builds dense atmospheric paintings from smoke-like marks, scraped color, and architectural rhythm.
artists.statement: A painting should not explain itself immediately. It should make the viewer adjust their eyes.

artists.name: Orkhan Garayev
artists.bio:
Orkhan Garayev (b. 1991, Ganja, Azerbaijan) is a contemporary Azerbaijani artist based in Baku. Working
across painting, graphic art, sculpture, installation, and book illustration, he explores the intersection of
cultural heritage and contemporary visual language. His practice is distinguished by symbolic imagery,
expressive color, and poetic narratives that reflect themes of memory, identity, and place. Garayev is a
member of the Union of Artists of Azerbaijan, the designer of official Azerbaijani postage stamps, and has
exhibited internationally. His works are held in public and private collections.
artists.statement:
«Red», «Trapped Earth», and «Hope» are part of the permanent collection of the Museum of
Modern Art in Baku.
His works have been showcased at international exhibitions in countries such as Turkey, Germany,
Russia, Georgia, Switzerland, France, the UAE, Luxembourg, and Belgium.

exhibitions.title: Seven Ya
exhibitions.description: A focused exhibition on layered identity, family memory, and the symbolic charge of repetition.

about.concept: ROOM is a contemporary art space in the heart of Baku where art, wine, and culture come together through exhibitions, talks, and curated encounters.
about.vision: To support contemporary artists and build a thoughtful creative community around collecting, learning, and conversation.
about.identity: Minimal, neutral, atmospheric, and emotionally precise. ROOM places the artwork first and lets the digital experience behave like a gallery visit.
